75.old_rule: Buy price = floor(card value × rarity multiplier × level multiplier × (100 − discount) / 100). Card value: augment 60, skill 100, doctrine 1,000 flat (doctrines have no rarity multiplier). Rarity multiplier (the equipment ones): Rare 2.5, Epic 4.0, Legendary 7.0. Level multiplier = 1 + (player's highest unlocked map level − 1) × 0.02 (same curve as equipment, economy_framework 13/17). Discount = 3% per Training Grounds level above L1 (L10 −27%). List prices at map L1 / 20 / 50 / 80 / 99: Rare augment 150 / 207 / 297 / 387 / 444; Epic augment 240 / 331 / 475 / 619 / 710; Legendary augment 420 / 579 / 831 / 1,083 / 1,243; Rare skill 250 / 345 / 495 / 645 / 740; Epic skill 400 / 552 / 792 / 1,032 / 1,184; Legendary skill 700 / 966 / 1,386 / 1,806 / 2,072; doctrine 1,000 / 1,380 / 1,980 / 2,580 / 2,960. Sell = floor(list price with no discount / 16) (the Merchant's 16:1), not changed by the Training Grounds level. Can't sell: augments attached to a skill, skill cards in a loadout, doctrines bound to a unit, or anything on a unit out on dispatch. Duplicates and starter cards can be sold. Every buy-then-sell route loses gold (Simulator 2026-11-04: 0 of 346,500 cases make gold; best case returns 25.3% of the price paid). Cards can't be turned into materials and nothing turns materials into cards. Every shelf card opens the existing card-details view (loadout_ui_spec 47) before buying.

79.old_rule: 2nd AUGMENT SLOT - LOCKED (USER RULING 2026-11-04): slot 2 of every skill row (including the doctrine skill row, Steal and every future skill) is open only when the unit's owner has Training Grounds effective level 10 (effective level = min(Training Grounds, Guild Hall), as for every facility) AND the unit is level 80+. Checked per unit; once both are true it opens by itself (neither goes back down in normal play). Slot 1 is always open. Equipping into a locked slot is refused; the slot shows a lock and the tooltip in row 83. A locked slot holding an augment (old saves, Studio test buttons that lower facility levels, anything else) sends the augment back to storage with the notice in row 83 (same pattern as frameworks 79); checked on load and whenever the Training Grounds level changes. ENEMY RULE (USER RULING 2026-11-04): only when the QUEST OWNER's Training Grounds effective level is 10 (checked when the battle is generated), each enemy at level 80+ rolls, deterministically from the battle seed, for each skill row, for a 2nd augment: Elite 100%, Veteran 50%, Grunt 25%. Before that, and for enemies below level 80, every enemy carries 1 augment per skill - Elites included (Elites carried 2 per skill at every level before this ruling; open_decisions 56). Bosses follow the Elite rule only if they use a generated loadout; authored loadouts stay as authored. Event units (Champion, mercenaries, etc.) use the tier they are mapped to. The 2nd augment uses the same fit and conflict checks (project_rules 221).
